title: Localization of a normalized global projection package
statement: Fix f:X to Y, ring sheaves RY,RX and an identification f-inverse RY isomorphic to RX. For every Global datum g of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data] and every object V of Y-pro-etale, there is a Local datum l at V satisfying ProjectionCompatible. This conclusion constructs one localized square from the supplied global package; it does not construct that global package or assert local detection of derived isomorphisms.

source.place: Tags 08FI (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), 0FN5 (lemma-localize-cartesian-square-modules), 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product); slice-topos restriction of the counit map 0B56.

proof.text: Obtain a Local datum l from the normalized local-data construction. This supplies the ordinary and derived operations, all tensor and shift comparisons, the normalized direct-image square and its pullback mate, including mate_counit.
Apply the localized tensor-square theorem to arbitrary derived inputs. It gives the pullback-tensor coherence for theta=l.pullback inverse, independently of any projection morphism.

Write each projection as the adjoint of its tensor comparison followed by counit tensor identity. Transpose both proposed paths under the local derived adjunction. Naturality of theta transports the global projection transpose; naturality of the X restriction and local tensor comparisons moves the counit and the direct-image comparison. Substitute the tensor-square equation and mate_counit. Functoriality of tensor and cancellation of theta with its inverse give equality of the two transposes. Injectivity of the adjunction hom-equivalence proves the original paths equal. Unfold sourceIso and targetIso to obtain precisely ProjectionCompatible; pair this proof with l.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 and 0B56; formal counit-mate calculation, matching the categorical argument of RingedExchangeTensorCoherence.

theorem localModel_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X)
    (g : Global f R_Y R_X c) (V : Y.ProEt) :
    ∃ l : Local f R_Y R_X c g V, l.ProjectionCompatible
